title: Insufficient funds (NSF)
body: If the ledger shows balance_recovered=true, retry the payment once. Otherwise acknowledge the exception and take no capture/refund action.

title: Expired card
body: Do not retry an expired card. Escalate so the customer can update credentials.

title: Acquirer network timeout
body: Retry once if retry_exhausted is false. If retries are exhausted, escalate to ops.

title: Fraud hold
body: Never retry or refund. Escalate to the risk queue at high severity.

title: Merchant decline
body: Hard decline from the merchant. Do not retry. Acknowledge and leave for merchant follow-up.

title: Payment still processing
body: Do not retry, refund, or acknowledge. Take no_action until the processor settles.

title: Captured payment refunds
body: Refund only captured/succeeded payments and only up to amount_cents. Over-refunds are blocked by guardrail; then take no_action.

title: 3-D Secure timeout
body: The challenge timed out before capture. Safe to retry once.

title: Currency mismatch
body: Ledger currency disagrees with the acquirer. Escalate; do not retry or refund.

title: Issuing bank holiday
body: Settlement delayed. Acknowledge the exception. Do not retry the same day.

title: Open chargeback
body: Chargeback is in flight. Escalate to risk. Do not refund out-of-band.

title: Duplicate payment attempt
body: A second authorization failed as duplicate. Acknowledge; do not retry. Refund only the extra captured duplicate (not this failed one).
